<js>
(function(){
  var m=String(baseUrl||'').match(/\/(?:book\/)?(\d+)(?:_\d+)?\.html|\/(\d+)\/?$/);
  var id=m?(m[1]||m[2]):'';
  return id ? source.bookSourceUrl.replace(/\?.*$/,'')+'read/'+id+'.html' : baseUrl;
})()
</js>
